quarterly_data.quarter: Mastercard press release: Mastercard Launches Wallet Pay to Scale Digital Wallets (09-09-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Mastercard launched Mastercard Wallet Pay, a global portfolio of solutions for digital wallets across NFC contactless, QR codes and online payments (interoperability, wallet-issued credit / debit / prepaid card programs, more than 3.7 billion Mastercard credentials connectable to wallets, transfers across 200-plus countries and territories and 150 currencies). Wallet providers using it include Alipay+ (Ant International's wallet gateway, connecting more than 50 e-wallets and banking apps) and its partner wallets AlipayHK, Clip, GCash, KakaoPay, TNG eWallet and TrueMoney, plus Axian, CRED, DaviPlata, Mercado Pago, MTN and TenPay Global; Mastercard says digital wallets serve over 4.3 billion users.
quarterly_data.figure: more than 3.7 billion Mastercard credentials; wallets serve over 4.3 billion users
